class.name: SteamInput
class.brief_description: Starts Steam Input and exposes connected controllers.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.input]. Start it on the main thread of the persistent client. Steam Input uses app settings by default and accepts an absolute path to a loose development manifest. Client scopes share the active native lease, manifest, and frame update. The game assigns each [SteamController] to a player independently of Godot joypad indices.

method.name: controllers
method.description: Returns a read-only snapshot of the connected controller views owned by this lease. Before start and after stop, returns an empty array.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts Steam Input. Leave [param manifest_path] empty to use Steam's app configuration or join the existing manifest. To override, pass an absolute path to a loose file Steam can read. A different explicit path while the lease is active returns [constant ERR_BUSY]. A missing file returns [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND]. Steam's parse rejection returns [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR]. An invalid path returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. A detached or unsupported scope returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: stop
method.description: Releases this lease and invalidates the views already returned by [method controllers]. The last active lease shuts down Steam Input. Stopping again is safe.

signal.name: bindings_changed
signal.description: Emitted when Steam reloads the configuration for a connected controller. Refresh cached HUD prompts.

signal.name: controller_connected
signal.description: Emitted after a new controller view appears in [method controllers]. A reconnect may produce a new view for the same hardware.

signal.name: controller_disconnected
signal.description: Emitted after a controller view is removed and invalidated. Use the supplied view to clear the local player assignment.
